title: 2747. Count Zero Request Servers

examples.explanation: For queries[0]: The servers with ids 1 and 2 get requests in the duration of [5, 10]. Hence, only server 3 gets zero requests. For queries[1]: Only the server with id 2 gets a request in duration of [6,11]. Hence, the servers with ids 1 and 3 are the only servers that do not receive any requests during that time period.
For queries[0]: All servers get at least one request in the duration of [1, 3]. For queries[1]: Only server with id 3 gets no request in the duration [2,4].
